summary: Open catalog and CLI for adding ready-made agents, commands, skills, MCP servers and hooks to Claude Code in one command.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Claude Code Templates is an open catalog of components for Claude Code, including agents, commands, skills, MCP integrations, settings, hooks, mods, loops and plugins. A CLI installs any of them with one command, and aitmpl.com lets you browse them.
sixtySeconds.problem: Setting up Claude Code with good agents and integrations takes time. This catalog lets you add tested components quickly.
whoFor: Claude Code users customising their setup
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a large, MIT-licensed catalog with a no-install npx CLI and exact install commands on every component page.

overview: Run npx claude-code-templates@latest to browse the catalog and install interactively, or pass flags such as --skill, --agent, --command or --mcp to install specific components. You can install a whole stack in one command.
Add --yes to skip the confirmation prompt. Every component page on aitmpl.com shows its exact install command. Mods, loops and plugins need recent Claude Code versions, as noted in the README.
The project is MIT licensed. Check what a component does before installing it, as with any third-party add-on.
limitations: Some types need newer Claude Code

install.verificationNote: Commands come from Claude Code Templates's README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.
